summary: Frontend-only verification of the reported Framer Motion crash (`positionalValues[name] is not a function`). Loaded / and /app in Playwright with full console + pageerror + network capture, hovered and dragged peel stickers, scrolled the entire 5300px landing page (word tower, poster reel, marquees, bento, CTA), and exercised the workspace tabs incl. a real Winston AI text verification. The Framer Motion error is GONE - zero pageerrors, zero 'positionalValues' / 'unit_conversion' / 'is not a function' / 'Cannot read properties of undefined' messages, and no CRA red error overlay on either route. Separately found a CRITICAL environment issue: the FastAPI backend was dead (all /api/* returning 502) because `pyzbar` failed at import with `ImportError: Unable to find zbar shared library`. libzbar0 is present on the host (aarch64), so a `supervisorctl restart backend` recovered it; /api/auth/me now returns a correct 401 for anonymous and the text checker returns real Winston results (96.5% human, 'Likely Authentic', confetti fires).

critical.issue: Backend was down (502 gateway) - uvicorn crashed at import: `from pyzbar.pyzbar import decode` -> ImportError: Unable to find zbar shared library. libzbar0 (0.23.92) IS installed at /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libzbar.so.0, so the load only failed for the process started before the lib was resolvable. Recovered with `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`. Make this resilient: ensure libzbar0 is installed in the image/startup script AND wrap the pyzbar import in try/except so QR decode degrades gracefully instead of taking down the whole API.

issues: 'FREE FOREVER PLAN' coral sticker and 'NO CARD NEEDED' mint sticker overlap at 1920px; the word 'PLAN' is hidden behind the mint sticker at rest (before any drag). Nudge the initial offsets apart.

design_issues.screen: Landing - fixed 'DRAG THE STICKERS' tip badge
issues: Fixed bottom-right tip sticker sits on top of page content (overlaps the marquee strip / footer area) at every scroll position; consider auto-dismiss or lower opacity after first interaction.
Confetti particles render above the result heading, briefly obscuring 'Likely Authentic'. Cosmetic; consider a lower z-index or pointer-events-none layer behind the card text.

action_items: Ensure libzbar0 is installed as part of environment setup and guard the pyzbar import in /app/backend/server.py with try/except so a missing native lib cannot 502 the entire API.
Fix overlapping CTA stickers ('FREE FOREVER PLAN' clipped by 'NO CARD NEEDED') on the landing page.
Optional: avoid the console-visible 401 from the unauthenticated /api/auth/me bootstrap call (treat 401 as expected/anonymous, or skip the call when no session token exists).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py imports pyzbar at module top-level; any native-library failure kills all endpoints. Import lazily inside the QR handler.

PopHeading now uses numeric `y: 24` and PeelSticker uses `initial={{rotate}}` + animate only - both verified clean at runtime; no remaining em/percent positional animate values found by grep across src.

success_rate.backend: not in scope (health only - /api/ 200, /api/auth/me 401 after restart)

test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md not needed - all tested flows are anonymous
context_for_next_testing_agent: Framer Motion positionalValues crash is fixed and verified on / and /app (no pageerrors, no dev-server overlay). Landing has 10 .peel stickers; hover + drag work. Workspace tabs tab-text/tab-image/tab-url/tab-qr/tab-payment all exist and switch; url-input appears on tab-url. Text verification via Winston AI works end-to-end (~<20s). Backend can crash on boot from pyzbar/libzbar - if you see 502 on /api/*, check /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log and restart backend. Not yet tested: image, QR, and payment-screenshot checkers, auth/signup, pricing/Stripe flows.
rca_of_the_issue: Original crash: framer-motion resolves positional keys (x/y/top/left...) through unit_conversion.positionalValues; a string value with an unsupported unit ('0.55em') made positionalValues[name] undefined -> 'is not a function'. Replacing it with numeric px in PopHeading (and removing the inline-style/animate rotate conflict in PeelSticker) resolved it; verified no such value remains in src. Secondary 502: uvicorn import-time ImportError from pyzbar's ctypes lookup of libzbar shared library; fixed by restarting backend once libzbar0 was resolvable.
